description: Calls a URL that asks for an x402 payment and pays it for you: the gateway pays the seller in USDC from its own float and charges this key in USDF cost plus 5% at most, no minimum (the seller's amount and a fee of at most 5% of it; never free credit), within the key's and its agent's limits. Needs an API key. Returns the seller's answer with the payment and its receipt; a payment is charged only once the chain shows it, and one that never settles costs nothing. quote: true answers what it would cost and pays nothing. Third-party tools to call this way are listed under marketplace in list_tools (GET /v1/tools?source=marketplace).

body.description: The request body: text, or JSON sent as application/json

headers.description: Headers for the seller (the payment headers are the gateway's)

max_price.description: The most to pay in USDF, the fee included ("0.05")

method.description: Default GET, or POST when a body is given

network.description: Pay on this network only: its CAIP-2 id, one GET /v1/x402/payer lists

quote.description: Answer the price and pay nothing

name: x402_pay
title: Pay an x402 URL
